app.title: Open File Recovery
app.subtitle: Data recovery for USB drives and SD cards

devices.title: Which device do you want to recover from?
devices.lead: Plug in the USB drive or SD card, then press Refresh. Nothing is ever written to the source device.
devices.empty: No devices found. Re-insert the media and press Refresh.
devices.imageHint: If you already made an image (.img), opening that is the safer route.
devices.adminNeeded: Reading a raw device needs administrator rights
devices.adminExplainMac: This app is running unprivileged, so reading a device directly will fail. Relaunch as administrator, or make an image with sudo from the CLI and open that image instead.
devices.adminExplainWin: This app is running unprivileged. Right-click the app and choose "Run as administrator" (the installed build asks at startup).

mode.title: What do you want to do?
mode.lead: If the media is failing, image it first. Every read can make it worse, so work from the image afterwards.

deleted.title: Find deleted files
deleted.desc: Look for files you deleted by accident and pull them out with their folder structure.

formatted.title: Recover from a formatted device
formatted.desc: A quick format only clears the index, so folders usually survive. This takes a while.

image.title: Image a failing device
image.desc: Grab the readable areas first and leave bad sectors for later. You can stop and resume.

copy.title: Copy everything as it is
copy.desc: Mirror what is on the device to another disk, keeping the same structure. Unreadable parts do not stop it.

carve.title: Search by file format (last resort)
carve.desc: For a destroyed file system. It finds the contents, but the original file names are gone for good.

run.cancelled: Stopped. Everything written so far is kept.
run.stalledHint: This is normal for failing media. Wait it out, or stop — everything read so far is kept.
run.cancelStuck: Cannot stop: the device is not responding
run.cancelStuckHint: The read is stuck, so the stop request cannot get through. Physically unplugging the media releases it. Everything read so far is saved, and running again with the same settings resumes from there.

image.title: Imaging settings
image.mapfileHint: A .map file is written next to it. You can stop and resume from there.
image.sameDiskWarning: The destination must be on a different disk from the source.
image.overwrite: Overwrite an image with the same name
image.resume: Found a resume record. Continuing from there.
image.incomplete: Some areas could not be read. Running again later retries only those areas.

scan.orphans: Also search leftover folders (needed after a format; takes longer)

bootSource.primary: The boot sector was read normally
bootSource.backup: The primary boot sector was damaged, so the backup was used
bootSource.estimated: No readable boot sector, so the geometry was estimated from the FAT. Results are less reliable

results.title: What was found
results.emptyHint: After a format, scan again with "search leftover folders" enabled. If the file system itself is gone, search by file format instead (names cannot be recovered).
results.previewNone: Select an item to see its contents
results.previewUnsupported: This format cannot be shown here. Restore it and check with a viewer.

concernHelp.contiguous: The cluster chain is gone, so the file was collected assuming it was stored in one piece. Fragmented files come back broken.
concernHelp.partialName: Deletion drops the first character of the short name. Nothing can bring it back.
concernHelp.conflicting: That area is in use by another file now, so it has probably been overwritten.
concernHelp.truncated: Could not collect as many bytes as the recorded size.

carved.title: Carved files
carved.noNames: Original names are gone. Check the contents before sorting them.

restore.title: Where should the files go?
restore.sameDiskWarning: The destination must be on a different disk. Writing to the source device overwrites the data you are trying to recover.
restore.flatten: Put everything in one folder instead of rebuilding the structure
restore.repairHint: If a file will not open, you can try repairing it.

copy.title: Copy settings
copy.onExisting: If a file with the same name exists

carve.title: Search by file format
carve.output: Where to put the carved files
carve.alignHint: If you know the cluster size (e.g. 4096), setting it makes this faster and more accurate.
carve.noNames: Original names cannot be recovered. Files with a readable capture date get it in the name.

repair.title: Repair a broken file
repair.lead: The original is never modified. The repaired copy is written as a separate file.
repair.referenceHint: A healthy file from the same device with the same settings improves the result. JPEG borrows the header, MP4 the moov layout, AVI the hdrl.
repair.mp4Expectation: Rebuilding an MP4 index without a reference file has a low success rate, commercial tools included. You get the video stream only, and audio is lost.
repair.videoVerify: Automatic checks for video stop at container consistency. Confirm playback in a player yourself.

errors.title: That did not work
errors.systemDisk: The startup disk cannot be a recovery source
errors.sameDevice: The destination is on the same device as the source
errors.noFilesystem: No FAT32 or exFAT volume found
errors.noFilesystemHint: The file system may be destroyed. Searching by file format still finds the contents (but not the names).
errors.sameDeviceHint: Choose another disk. Writing to the source device overwrites the data you want back.

safety.readOnly: Never writes to the source device
safety.imageFirst: For failing media, image it first and work from the image. Every read can make it worse.
safety.liveDevice: This will read the device directly
